purpose: How a residential water-treatment business turns systems it has already installed into a durable consumables annuity: deriving per-class replacement intervals from what actually exhausts each media, designing service-plan tiers and a disclosed agreement against a cost stack rebuilt from real invoices and timesheets, running the due-date, reminder and routing machinery that converts a due date into a completed visit, using periodic retests as honest documented proof of value, and diagnosing, saving, transferring and measuring accounts so the book compounds through referral instead of leaking through churn.
assumptions: no observed dataset supplied; all scores are heuristic priors

the business installs and services residential point-of-use and point-of-entry water treatment and already has an installed base to service; the first sale and the physical installation are owned by the two sibling knowledge bases and arrive here as a handoff record

consumable intervals begin at the installed model's published rating and are adjusted by this household's water and use; no interval, price, margin, attach rate or churn rate here is asserted as an industry figure

the operator can retrieve their own distributor invoices, freight bills, timesheets, service history and payment-processor statements; every economic statement in this knowledge base is a computation over those documents

consumer-contract, automatic-renewal, electronic-messaging-consent, personal-data, plumbing-code and contractor-licensing requirements are obligation classes that differ by jurisdiction and change over time, so current rules must be verified locally with a qualified adviser
claims usable with an existing customer are limited to the parameters the installed system was sold to change, measured at the same sample point and by the same method as the commissioning baseline
exclusions: segmenting prospects by water problem class, reading municipal water-quality reports, running the first-visit diagnostic conversation, escalating to an accredited laboratory as part of the initial sale, and designing the softener, carbon and reverse-osmosis offer architecture: the water-treatment offers and honest diagnostics knowledge base owns that territory and this one consumes its verified output

sizing systems to household demand and water chemistry, placement, bypass, drain and air-gap design, permit filing and plumbing-code compliance, subcontract-versus-in-house install labor, install workmanship and leak-risk control at installation, and the commissioning tests themselves: the system sizing, installation and plumbing-compliance knowledge base owns that territory and this one begins at the handoff record it produces

any health, medical, disease or wellness claim about water or treatment; service, renewal, retest and referral language is limited to the measured parameters the installed system was sold to change and to the maintenance mechanism that keeps them there, never to what water does to a body

fear-based renewal or winback selling, manufactured urgency, expiring same-visit save offers, and any demonstration such as a stained spent cartridge, a precipitation trick or an electrolysis device presented as proof of contamination; a spent consumable is evidence that a consumable has a finite life and nothing more

invented figures for plan prices, service margins, attach rates, churn rates, revenue per account, book multiples or market sizes; money and retention appear only as mechanisms whose inputs are named and verified per account from distributor invoices, freight bills, timesheets, processor statements and the operator's own ledger

asserting any jurisdiction's specific automatic-renewal, cooling-off, cancellation-fee, messaging-consent, privacy, review-disclosure, plumbing-code or contractor-licensing rule as fact; each is named as an obligation class with an instruction to verify current local requirements
personalized financial, legal, tax, insurance or medical advice; this is operator education about running the recurring side of a water-treatment business

commercial, industrial, municipal and agricultural water-treatment service contracts, well drilling and pump service, whole-house repiping, septic and water-heater work; the scope is residential equipment that is already installed

glossary.definition: The recurring revenue that exists because treatment media has a finite working life: every installed system consumes cartridges, resin capacity, membranes, salt or lamps on a schedule, so the equipment sale creates a repeating service obligation that can be operated as a book.

The roster of installed systems the business services, held one record per system rather than per customer, carrying the equipment identity, consumable parts list, commissioning baseline, plan state, consent state and next-due date per replaceable component.

The point at which the parameter a system was sold to control begins appearing downstream again, such as hardness at the tap as an exhausted resin bed stops exchanging or chlorine taste returning as a carbon bed passes its adsorption capacity; it is the observable end of a consumable's useful life.

The manufacturer's stated volume or capacity a consumable is qualified for under a defined test water; it is the honest starting point for an interval, not a promise for a specific household, because real influent loading and usage move it in either direction.

Enrolling a newly installed system onto a service plan, most cheaply at the install handoff itself; attach rate is computed by the operator as enrollments over installs handed off in a period, never quoted from an outside figure.

The defined period after a plan ends or a service is missed during which the account is still treated as recoverable and the equipment is still straightforwardly serviceable, after which the account moves to a winback track or is closed with a recorded reason.

The rhythm of re-measuring the parameters the installed system was sold to change, at the same sample point and by the same method as the commissioning baseline, so the plan's value is documented as a dated comparison rather than asserted.

How many serviceable stops sit within a short drive of one another; it is the main controllable input to service margin, which is why due accounts are batched into geographic cluster days rather than dispatched in request order.

Equipment installed by another company or a previous owner that the business is asked to service; it needs equipment identification, parts-availability confirmation and a condition assessment before any plan promise can honestly be made about it.

An account that stops paying without deciding to leave, typically an expired card, a failed direct debit or an unopened invoice; it is separated from decided cancellations because the fix is a billing retry and a contact, not a save offer.

nodes.definition: The service book is the operating asset this entire subdomain manages: one record per installed system rather than per customer, holding the property address and access notes, the treatment class and the specific model actually installed, serial and install date, the exact consumable bill of materials (cartridge dimensions and micron rating, media type and bed volume, membrane and lamp part numbers, O-ring and sanitizer kit), the commissioning baseline readings handed over by the install team, the plan state and its term dates, the contact and consent state, and a next-service-due date for each replaceable component. Defining these fields before anything else is the actual work, because a book that records only that a customer bought a filter cannot be scheduled, priced, transferred when the house sells, or measured, and every mechanism downstream in this knowledge base reads or writes one of its fields.

included: consumable bill of materials per installed unit
commissioning baseline carried forward from the install handoff
excluded: choosing or sizing the equipment
the installation record, permit file and code compliance
prospect segmentation and the diagnostic sale

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: the record schema is extended, a new equipment class enters the book, or a field audit shows records disagreeing with what is installed

pros.claim: A per-system record carrying an exact parts list makes every later step mechanical instead of investigative
pros.example: a technician arriving with the right 4.5 by 20 inch carbon block and the right housing O-ring because the record names the model, not just whole-house filter

cons.claim: Field discipline costs time at handoff and decays quickly unless one person owns the record
cons.example: half the book showing filter as the model because installers were allowed to type free text into the equipment field

failure_modes: keeping the book as a pile of invoices in accounting software, so no next-due date exists anywhere
recording the customer but not the equipment, so a house sale silently erases the annuity
free-text model and serial fields that make parts planning and warranty claims impossible later
acceptance_tests: every active system in the book resolves to a model class, a consumable parts list, an install date and a next-due date per replaceable component
a randomly chosen account can be serviced from its record alone, without phoning the original installer
revisit_triggers: a new equipment class enters the offer and has no parts list in the record schema
technicians repeatedly find equipment on site that disagrees with the record

nodes.definition: The rule set governing every sentence said to an existing customer about why their filter should be changed, their plan renewed, or their neighbour called. Permitted language is limited to what the installed treatment class verifiably does to measured parameters (a carbon block reduces the chlorine taste it was sold to reduce; a softener holds hardness near the level recorded at commissioning) and to the maintenance mechanism itself (media has finite capacity, membranes foul, lamps lose output). It forbids health, disease and detox framing; forbids presenting a stained spent cartridge, a precipitation trick or an electrolysis device as proof of danger; forbids urgency that was manufactured rather than derived from throughput or a dated reading; and requires deliberate care with elderly, anxious or isolated customers who are easy to frighten into buying service they do not need. It is a first-class node precisely because renewal season is when the temptation to scare is strongest.

included: permitted claim set for service, renewal and referral
prohibition on health and medical framing
prohibition on fear demonstrations and manufactured urgency
care rules for customers who are easily pressured
excluded: the first-sale diagnostic conversation and offer presentation
laboratory method and standards interpretation
plumbing-code and licensing compliance

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a complaint, a regulator inquiry, or a supplier claim set that would require the permitted language list to be rewritten

pros.claim: A written boundary makes every renewal script auditable and survivable when a complaint or a regulator arrives
pros.example: a lapse call that says the carbon is past its rated throughput and shows last year's taste and chlorine readings, instead of saying the water has become unsafe

cons.claim: Honest language converts worse than fear in the short run, and staff paid per renewal feel that cost personally
cons.example: a technician who may not caption a sediment-stained prefilter photo as look what was in your water

failure_modes: a spent cartridge photographed and captioned as contamination evidence
renewal urgency invented rather than derived from rated throughput or a dated reading
an outsourced call centre improvising health language that nobody in the business audits
acceptance_tests: every renewal, winback and referral script traces each claim to a measured parameter or a documented maintenance mechanism
no script or visual asset contains a health, disease or bodily-purity claim, and no image is captioned as proof of contamination
revisit_triggers: a customer complaint alleges pressure, scare tactics or an over-promised outcome
a new product class arrives with supplier marketing copy that outruns what it verifiably does

nodes.definition: The physical mechanisms that end a consumable's useful life, which is what any replacement interval is merely a proxy for. A softener resin bed is consumed by ion-exchange capacity used up, which is hardness load multiplied by volume treated between regenerations, and is degraded further by iron fouling or chlorine attack. Carbon ends when adsorption capacity is spent or when the bed channels and empty-bed contact time collapses. A sediment prefilter ends on pressure drop rather than on any capacity number. A reverse-osmosis membrane degrades by fouling, scaling and oxidation, showing up as falling permeate flow and loss of rejection. A UV lamp ends on output decay and sleeve fouling on a calendar regardless of how much water passed. The expert work is mapping each installed component to its governing mechanism and to the observable that reveals exhaustion, so intervals can be justified, defended and tuned instead of guessed.

included: the on-site observable that reveals it
the influent and usage variables that move it
excluded: selecting or sizing the equipment in the first place
the schedule arithmetic itself
plan pricing and tier design

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: field evidence or a supplier technical bulletin that contradicts the assumed exhaustion mechanism for a component class

pros.claim: Knowing the mechanism lets an interval be defended to a sceptical customer and shortened or lengthened on evidence rather than on habit
pros.example: explaining that a household of five on a chlorinated main reaches a carbon block's rated throughput sooner than the two-person home the brochure figure assumes

cons.claim: Mechanistic reasoning depends on inputs most small operators do not measure continuously, so it still terminates in an estimate
cons.example: no flow meter on a whole-house carbon unit, so throughput is inferred from occupancy and utility billing rather than measured directly

failure_modes: treating every cartridge as a six-month calendar item regardless of which mechanism actually governs it
ignoring that a single chlorine or scaling event can end a membrane long before its rated life
assuming a manufacturer rating measured on test water describes this household's water
acceptance_tests: each replaceable component class in the book is mapped to its exhaustion mechanism and to at least one observable a technician can check on site
revisit_triggers: a component class begins failing earlier or lasting far longer than its mechanism predicts
a supplier changes media formulation, membrane construction or the basis of its rating

nodes.definition: Writing the plan agreement so the recurring relationship is legible before any money moves: what the plan includes (which consumables, whose labor, how many visits, what response commitment), what it excludes (equipment replacement, plumbing beyond the connection, customer-supplied parts), the term and what happens when it ends, how renewal occurs and exactly how it is cancelled, how a price change is noticed, whether the plan transfers when the property is sold, and what happens to prepaid amounts on cancellation. Automatic renewal and negative-option billing, cooling-off or right-to-cancel windows, door-to-door sales rules and cancellation-fee limits are obligation classes that differ by jurisdiction and change over time: the expert names each class, drafts to the strictest plausible reading, and verifies current local requirements with a qualified adviser rather than asserting any specific rule as fact.

included: obligation classes flagged for local verification
excluded: asserting any jurisdiction's specific statute, cooling-off length or fee cap as fact
giving legal advice
the installation contract, permit paperwork and code sign-off

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a change in an applicable consumer-contract obligation class, or a dispute pattern that shows a clause is being misread

pros.claim: A plain-language inclusion and exclusion list is the cheapest churn prevention available, because most cancellations begin as I thought that was covered
pros.example: the agreement stating that a failed control valve is an equipment matter routed through the manufacturer warranty while the plan covers the labor to diagnose and fit it

cons.claim: Tight, lawyer-shaped terms read as distrust at the kitchen table and slow attach at exactly the moment attach is cheapest
cons.example: a homeowner hesitating over a multi-page agreement for what they understood to be a cartridge reminder service

failure_modes: automatic renewal buried where a customer will later credibly say they never saw it
no assignment clause, so every property sale in the book is a total loss
verbal promises of everything included that the written document contradicts
acceptance_tests: the agreement states inclusions, exclusions, term, renewal mechanism, cancellation path, price-change notice and transferability in plain language on one readable page
every regulatory point in the agreement is recorded as an obligation class with an instruction to verify current local rules, never as an asserted statute
revisit_triggers: a consumer-protection, automatic-renewal or door-to-door rule change is reported in an operating jurisdiction
a cancellation dispute reveals a term that customers systematically misread

nodes.definition: The account record that makes reminders possible is simultaneously a consent and privacy obligation. This unit captures which channels the customer actually agreed to (voice call, text message, email, post), when and how that agreement was recorded, how a stop request is made and how it propagates across every tool and every list the business uses, how long water test results and service history are retained and who inside the business may see them, and the standing rule that a customer's own test results are service data rather than a lever for pressure marketing or material to be sold or shared with third parties. Electronic-messaging consent, marketing-list rules and personal-data handling are obligation classes that vary by jurisdiction and by channel; they are named here and verified locally rather than assumed to travel from one market to another.

included: per-channel consent capture with a timestamp
opt-out propagation across tools and lists
retention limits and internal access rules for test and service history
prohibition on using customer test results as marketing or resale material
excluded: the reminder ladder's timing and copy
referral incentive design
asserting any specific statute's requirements as fact

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a change in an applicable messaging or privacy obligation class, or an audit showing opt-outs failing to propagate

pros.claim: Clean channel-level consent is what makes the reminder machine safe to automate at book scale
pros.example: a due-date text sent only to accounts whose channel preference and consent were captured on the handoff form and timestamped

cons.claim: Consent discipline shrinks the reachable list and pushes some recoverable accounts onto the most expensive channel
cons.example: a lapsed account that only ever consented to post, so the winback must go by letter rather than by the cheap text sequence

failure_modes: a purchased or scraped list dropped into the same reminder system as consented accounts
an opt-out honoured in the scheduling tool while the marketing tool keeps sending
a customer's laboratory result quoted in a neighbourhood sales pitch
acceptance_tests: every contactable account carries a channel-level consent state with a capture date, and a single opt-out action suppresses every channel and every list
no water test result leaves the service context for marketing use without separately recorded permission
revisit_triggers: a messaging-consent or personal-data obligation class changes in an operating jurisdiction
complaint or bounce patterns suggest the recorded consent state is wrong

nodes.definition: Turning exhaustion mechanisms into a schedule the business can actually operate: for each treatment class in the book, an interval expressed on the variable that governs it. Softener media is tracked on capacity consumed and confirmed by an observed hardness check, with a salt-supply and brine-tank cadence in between; whole-house carbon runs on rated throughput adjusted for occupancy and the influent's chlorine or chloramine load; sediment prefilters run on pressure drop with a conservative default date behind it; reverse-osmosis stages take a staged calendar with the membrane held on its own performance trigger; ultraviolet lamps take the manufacturer's calendar. The starting point is always the installed model's published rating, the adjustment comes from this household's water and use, the result is written into the record as a due date per component, and the whole set is revised from field evidence rather than quoted as a universal number that applies to every customer.

included: manufacturer rating as the starting point
writing a due date per component into the record
excluded: sizing the equipment to the household
the price of the service visit
route sequencing and reminder copy

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: accumulated service findings, a supplier rating change, or a source-water change that shifts the load a class is carrying

pros.claim: Class-specific intervals suppress the two costly errors at once: servicing early burns margin and goodwill, servicing late produces breakthrough, complaints and a cancellation conversation
pros.example: moving a chlorinated-main household's carbon block earlier while leaving a well household's sediment cartridge on a pressure-drop trigger

cons.claim: Per-household tuning multiplies the variants the scheduler, the van stock list and the billing system must carry
cons.example: three interval variants for the same carbon housing across one suburb, so the stocking list stops being a single line

failure_modes: copying a brochure interval into every account regardless of influent load or occupancy
setting one interval for a whole system instead of one per replaceable component
never revising an interval after service visits repeatedly contradict it
acceptance_tests: every component in the book carries an interval whose basis is named as throughput, capacity, pressure drop, calendar or performance trigger, and is attributable to the installed model's rating plus a stated household adjustment
revisit_triggers: service visits repeatedly find media spent well before its date or barely used at its date
the municipal supply or the well condition changes for a geography in the book

nodes.definition: How the money in a service plan comes to exist, stated as a mechanism the operator computes from their own documents rather than as figures anyone can quote. Per serviced system per year the cost stack is: consumable parts at the actual distributor invoice plus freight and any disposal or core charge; technician time for the visit at loaded cost, including the drive time between stops; vehicle and stock-carrying cost; the retest kit or laboratory fee where the tier includes one; a reserve for callbacks and warranty labor; and the payment-processing and administrative cost of billing a recurring charge. Plan revenue is whatever the tier design and the local market support; margin is the difference, and it moves with drive density, interval length, parts cost changes and callback rate. The expert keeps this stack current per model class from real invoices and timesheets and re-derives it before any tier or price decision, rather than trusting a remembered number.

included: named cost inputs and the document each is verified from
excluded: any asserted price, margin percentage or industry benchmark
equipment margin at the point of first sale
tax and accounting treatment of deferred plan revenue

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a dated change in any named cost input, or a booked-history review showing realised cost per visit diverging from the stack

pros.claim: A live cost stack turns pricing from a guess into arithmetic and exposes plans that have been quietly losing money
pros.example: discovering that a rural cluster's drive time rather than its cartridge cost is what makes a low-priced annual plan unprofitable

cons.claim: The stack is only as good as the bookkeeping feeding it, and small operators frequently lack a clean labor cost per visit
cons.example: an owner-operator who never prices their own time, so every plan appears profitable on paper

failure_modes: pricing a plan from the cartridge cost alone and meeting the labor cost only at year end
carrying last season's parts and freight cost after a supplier increase
keeping callbacks and warranty labor outside the stack so margin looks better than it is
acceptance_tests: every cost input in the stack names the document it was verified from, whether distributor invoice, freight bill, timesheet or processor statement, and carries a date
no figure used in a plan economics decision is asserted without a source document behind it
revisit_triggers: a supplier price or freight change lands
callback and warranty labor rises for a model class
account density changes materially in a service geography

nodes.definition: Deciding what a customer can actually buy: a short ladder of plan tiers set against plain a-la-carte service, built so each tier is a coherent promise rather than a discount. The menu items in this trade are well known: scheduled consumables, the labor to fit them, salt delivery or brine-tank service on softener accounts, sanitizing where the class requires it, a periodic retest with a written comparison, a leak and connection check, a response commitment, and a reduced or waived charge on out-of-cycle callouts. A-la-carte stays available for households that refuse commitment, for orphan systems the business will not warrant, and for one-off failures. The design question for every item is the same: does it belong inside a recurring price because it is predictable, frequent and cheap to deliver on route, or must it stay per-event because it is unpredictable, expensive, or dependent on parts availability the business does not control.

included: keeping tier content identical to the agreement's inclusion list
excluded: the equipment offer tiers sold at first purchase
specific prices or discount levels
install scope and change orders

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: cohort evidence that a tier is unprofitable, undeliverable, or systematically avoided by customers

pros.claim: Bundling only route-predictable items keeps the promise deliverable and stops a tier from becoming unbounded insurance
pros.example: putting the annual cartridge change and a retest inside the plan while leaving control-valve replacement outside as a warranty-linked, per-event job

cons.claim: Every extra tier multiplies the inclusion lists schedulers, technicians and billing must keep straight
cons.example: three current tiers plus grandfathered legacy plans producing five different answers to what is covered at the door

failure_modes: a top tier promising unlimited callouts with no cost reserve behind it
tiers that differ only by discount, so nothing distinguishes them except price
marketing inclusion lists that do not match the agreement text
acceptance_tests: each tier's inclusion list matches the agreement wording exactly and every included item is one the route plan and parts supply can actually deliver
each included item passes the predictability-and-cost test recorded against the current cost stack
revisit_triggers: a tier's realised fulfilment or callback cost drifts away from its cost stack
customers systematically buy around a tier or repeatedly ask for an item no tier contains

nodes.definition: The second fulfilment channel for the annuity: shipping consumables to the homeowner to fit themselves, restricted to components where that is safe and reversible. Under-sink and countertop cartridges on quarter-turn heads, refrigerator and inline filters, and some simple housing cartridges are candidates. Anything that requires a pressure vessel to be opened, a resin or brine operation, a sanitizing step, a membrane change with a flush-and-verify sequence, or a lamp change behind a quartz sleeve normally stays with a technician. The unit defines the eligibility rule per component, the written instructions covering isolation, depressurizing and a post-fit leak check, the old-part disposal question, and the confirmation step that detects a shipment which was never fitted. It also states honestly what the channel costs the business: it is cheaper and popular with capable owners, but it removes the visit where leaks are caught, drift is spotted and the next renewal is earned.

included: detection of shipments that were never fitted
the touchpoint and inspection given up by shipping
excluded: the technician visit protocol
sizing or installation work
tier pricing levels

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: complaint or confirmation data comparing shipped accounts against technician-serviced accounts, or a hardware change affecting handling safety

pros.claim: Shipping keeps low-value and distant accounts inside the annuity that a truck roll could never serve profitably
pros.example: a single under-sink reverse-osmosis account an hour beyond the route area kept on cartridge shipments with a technician visit only for the membrane

cons.claim: A shipped part is not a serviced system: the inspection is lost and an unfitted cartridge quietly becomes an unhappy customer
cons.example: a box of prefilters sitting in a garage while the customer tells a neighbour the taste came back

failure_modes: shipping a component whose replacement requires opening a pressurized vessel
no confirmation step, so the record marks the system serviced when nothing was fitted
instructions that omit shut-off, depressurizing and the post-fit leak check
acceptance_tests: every component flagged shippable passes a written eligibility rule covering pressure, sanitation and verification requirements
each shipment has a fitted-confirmation step that updates the record before the next due date is computed
revisit_triggers: shipped accounts show more taste or performance complaints than technician-serviced accounts
a supplier changes a cartridge head or housing design in a way that alters safe do-it-yourself handling

nodes.definition: Enrolling the plan at the one moment when the equipment is new, visibly working, and the homeowner is standing in front of it: the install handoff. The work is a scripted, pressure-free enrollment built on the commissioning record the install team leaves behind, showing the readings just taken beside the customer's original baseline, naming the consumables this specific system will need and roughly when, explaining that the maintenance is what holds the readings where they now are, and offering the plan and the a-la-carte alternative side by side with the agreement in hand. Attach here costs no extra drive time and starts the due-date clock from a known commissioning date; recovering an account that declined at handoff is materially harder and more expensive later, which is why this is a distinct unit of work rather than a line in a sales campaign.

included: handoff enrollment script and the evidence it stands on
consent and channel capture at enrollment
starting the clock from the commissioning date
excluded: the commissioning tests and homeowner orientation themselves
the original equipment sale
install workmanship and code sign-off

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: attach and early-cancellation outcomes by crew, or a change in the handoff artifact the install process produces

pros.claim: Attaching at handoff converts on demonstrated performance rather than on persuasion, and costs no separate visit
pros.example: signing the plan while the just-commissioned softener's hardness reading sits on the handoff sheet next to the customer's own pre-install baseline

cons.claim: A handoff already carrying orientation can tip into feeling like a second sales pitch at the end of a long install day
cons.example: a tired homeowner agreeing to a plan they cancel three weeks later because the enrollment came after five hours of work in their basement

failure_modes: enrolling by default rather than on an explicit informed yes
installers skipping enrollment because it is neither their job nor in their pay
starting the service clock from the sale date instead of the commissioning date
acceptance_tests: every handoff produces a recorded decision of enrolled, declined with a-la-carte terms explained, or deferred with a follow-up date, plus a consent and channel state
the first due dates in the record are computed from the commissioning date and the components actually installed
revisit_triggers: attach outcomes diverge sharply between install crews
cancellations cluster in the first weeks after handoff

nodes.definition: The mechanism that converts a static book into a dated work queue. For each installed component, next-due is the last-serviced date plus the interval its class specifies, shifted by whatever usage proxy or field trigger the business actually tracks: an occupancy change, a regeneration or meter count where the equipment reports one, a customer-reported taste or pressure symptom. The engine groups a system's components so a single visit covers everything falling due inside a tolerance window instead of making four trips to one address, produces a rolling horizon queue that the route planner can consume, and flags accounts whose due date has passed with no booking and no recorded reason. It is deliberately separated from the reminder ladder: this unit decides what is due, the ladder decides how the customer is asked.

included: grouping components into one visit inside a tolerance window
rolling work queue and overdue ageing flags
excluded: outreach copy and cadence
route sequencing and technician assignment
what happens during the visit

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an interval revision, a new usage signal becoming available, or an audit showing computed due dates diverging from what was serviced

pros.claim: A computed queue turns an annuity from something remembered into something operated, and makes overdue accounts visible before they become cancellations
pros.example: a weekly queue surfacing every softener account whose salt-service date passed more than two weeks ago

cons.claim: Grouping components into a single visit necessarily replaces some parts early, spending consumable life to buy route efficiency
cons.example: changing a sediment prefilter two months ahead of its pressure-drop trigger because the carbon block was due and the van was already at the house

failure_modes: a single system-level due date that ignores differences between components
no overdue queue, so lapsed accounts are noticed only when the customer complains
silent drift when a visit is completed but the record is never dated
acceptance_tests: every active component has a computed next-due date that the queue can reproduce from last-serviced plus interval plus recorded adjustments
overdue accounts appear on a queue with an age attached rather than in someone's memory
revisit_triggers: overdue counts grow faster than the book does
an interval change requires bulk recomputation of existing due dates

nodes.definition: The outreach machine that turns a due date into a booked appointment: an escalating sequence inside consented channels, beginning with an early notice that names the component and why it is due, then a booking path offering concrete windows, then a reminder before the window closes, then a human call for non-responders, and finally a defined stop point that moves the account to the lapse track instead of nagging it forever. The craft is in specificity, naming the part, the last reading and the date rather than saying it is time for your annual service; in making booking a single step rather than a phone call available only during working hours; in confirming and reconfirming so no-shows do not destroy the route density the margin depends on; and in keeping every message inside the claim boundary, where a service is due because media has a finite rated life, never because the water has become dangerous.

included: non-responder escalation and a defined stop point
excluded: computing what is due
route sequencing and technician assignment
winback of accounts that have already lapsed

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: step-level booking conversion and opt-out data, or a change in an applicable messaging obligation class

pros.claim: A ladder with a stop point converts the responsive majority cheaply and hands the rest to a save motion instead of burning goodwill
pros.example: two automated notices and one human call, after which the account moves to the lapse track with its non-response recorded

cons.claim: Every additional contact raises annoyance and opt-out risk, and an opt-out permanently shrinks the reachable book
cons.example: a fourth message that produces one booking and three opt-outs, one of them from an otherwise excellent account

failure_modes: generic reminders that never name the component or quote the last reading
a booking path that requires a phone call during business hours only
continuing outreach on a channel the customer has opted out of
acceptance_tests: each step names the component due and offers a one-step booking path, and the sequence terminates at a defined point that records an outcome
no step sends on a channel without a recorded consent state for that account
revisit_triggers: booking conversion falls on a channel or at a particular step
opt-out rate rises after a sequence or copy change

nodes.definition: Making the annuity physically deliverable at a margin: batching due accounts by geography and week so drive time per stop falls, holding cluster days for particular suburbs or valleys, sequencing appointment windows to what a technician can genuinely finish with the parts on the van, reserving capacity for emergencies and callbacks so one leak does not shatter a planned week, and smoothing seasonal load such as softener salt in cold months or taste complaints during summer chlorination changes. It also fixes the boundary of the serviceable area, decides which outlying accounts belong on the shipment channel instead of a truck roll, and drives the parts stocking list so nobody stands in a customer's garage without the cartridge the record already named.

included: van stock list built from the record
excluded: the install crew's scheduling and job sequencing
replacement interval derivation
plan pricing

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: realised stops per day, second-trip rate and drive time per stop measured from the operator's own dispatch history

pros.claim: Drive density is the largest controllable input to service margin, and batching is how it is bought
pros.example: one cluster day per suburb turning three scattered stops into six neighbouring ones for the same drive time

cons.claim: Batching pulls services away from their ideal dates and can push a customer's preferred window weeks out
cons.example: a customer offered a slot three weeks away because their area's cluster day runs monthly

failure_modes: dispatching in request order rather than by geography, so drive time consumes the plan margin
no callback reserve, so every emergency displaces booked plan work
loading the van from memory and losing a second trip to a missing part
acceptance_tests: the planned week shows stops grouped by geography with a stated reserve for callbacks, and every planned stop has its parts identified from the record before the van is loaded
revisit_triggers: account density changes materially in a service geography
second-trip, overrun or no-show rates rise

nodes.definition: What happens at the stop, standardized so any technician leaves the same evidence behind: confirm the system and its components against the record before touching anything, isolate and depressurize correctly, replace what is due with the specified part, sanitize where the class requires it, restore pressure slowly with a documented leak check at every joint disturbed, take a working verification reading showing the system is producing water in the condition it is meant to, note salt level and brine-tank condition on softener accounts, photograph the installation state, and close by dating the record, updating the next-due dates and telling the homeowner in plain language what was done and what was found. The visit is simultaneously the delivery of the plan, the inspection that catches slow failures before they become water damage, and the moment at which the next renewal is either earned or quietly lost.

excluded: new installation or repiping work
code-scope changes and permit matters
selling new equipment beyond disclosing what was found

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: callback, leak and record-completeness rates by technician, or a new equipment class requiring different handling steps

pros.claim: A standard visit makes quality independent of which technician attended, and its captured readings are the raw material for both proof of value and drift detection
pros.example: every visit leaving a dated post-service reading, so a taste complaint six weeks later has a baseline to argue from rather than two opinions

cons.claim: Protocol discipline costs minutes at every stop that route planning immediately wants back
cons.example: the photo and reading steps adding time on a day already tight with six appointments and a callback

failure_modes: reassembling without a pressurized leak check and creating a callback or a water-damage claim
fitting the part but never dating the record, so the next due date is wrong for a year
using the visit as an equipment sales call rather than reporting findings
acceptance_tests: every completed visit produces a dated record listing parts fitted, a post-service verification reading, a leak-check confirmation and updated next-due dates
no visit closes with a disturbed joint left unchecked under restored pressure
revisit_triggers: callback or leak incidents rise following visits
post-service readings are missing or implausible for a technician or crew

nodes.definition: Reading the signals that a system has stopped doing what it was sold to do and deciding which of three different worlds you are in. Consumable exhaustion looks like hardness appearing at the tap late in a resin cycle, taste returning as carbon passes its rated throughput, or pressure dropping across a loaded sediment cartridge. Equipment fault looks like a control valve stuck in bypass, a leaking brine line, a reverse-osmosis shut-off valve that never closes, or a failed ultraviolet ballast. A source change looks like a municipal disinfectant switch, a seasonal blend, or a well that has silted, gone turbid or changed bacteriologically. Each has a different owner, a different cost and a different conversation, and confusing one for another is exactly how a business either absorbs an equipment cost it never owed or bills a customer for a cartridge that was never the problem.

included: symptom-to-cause triage across exhaustion, equipment fault and source change
the on-site checks that separate them
escalation when the cause sits upstream of the equipment
excluded: any health interpretation of a finding
the original diagnostic sale and treatment selection
adjudicating who pays, which is the warranty unit

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: repeat-visit and misdiagnosis patterns by symptom, or a confirmed source-water change in a serviced area

pros.claim: Correct triage protects margin and trust at once, because the customer hears a cause rather than another sale
pros.example: finding a softener valve stuck in bypass instead of selling a resin replacement that would have changed nothing

cons.claim: Triage needs instrumentation and technician judgment that a low-cost service model may not put on every van
cons.example: no meter on the van, so a reverse-osmosis complaint gets a membrane swap by default and the real fault survives

failure_modes: replacing consumables until a symptom disappears without ever finding the fault
blaming source water for a problem the equipment itself is causing
treating a bacteriological or well-condition finding as something a filter service plan can settle
acceptance_tests: every drift complaint closes with a named cause class of exhaustion, equipment fault or source change, supported by an on-site observation recorded in the account
revisit_triggers: a symptom pattern repeats across a model class or a service geography
a supply-side change is announced or detected for a service area

nodes.definition: The rhythm of re-measuring the parameters the system was sold to change and reporting them honestly, so the plan's value is visible rather than assumed. The work is deciding what to retest per class (hardness and regeneration behaviour on softeners; the taste, odour and chlorine indicators or any parameter named in the original quote on carbon; rejection and permeate flow on reverse osmosis; lamp hours and sleeve condition on ultraviolet), at what cadence (at least one comparison per plan year for most classes, sooner where the source is variable or the customer has raised a concern), how to present it (today's reading beside the commissioning baseline and the previous reading, with what changed stated plainly), and where the honest limit of field screening sits, beyond which a finding must go to an accredited laboratory rather than be settled on a kitchen counter. Results are reported as chemistry against the parameters in scope, never as a statement about anybody's health.

included: the escalation threshold to an accredited laboratory
excluded: health interpretation of any result
the initial diagnostic workup that selected the treatment class
laboratory method selection and accreditation assessment

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: retest-versus-perception disagreement, a method or kit change, or a supply change that alters which parameters matter

pros.claim: A dated comparison converts an invisible service into evidence and is the strongest honest argument available at renewal
pros.example: a single sheet showing commissioning hardness, last year's reading and today's, all taken at the same tap by the same method

cons.claim: Retesting costs kit, time and occasionally produces an inconvenient result that must then be dealt with rather than buried
cons.example: a retest showing the system is no longer holding the parameter, turning a routine renewal visit into a warranty investigation

failure_modes: retesting at a different sample point or by a different method than the baseline, making the comparison meaningless
reporting only the parameters that improved
using a retest result as the opening for fear-based upselling
acceptance_tests: each plan year produces a dated retest of the parameters the system was sold to change, taken at the same sample point and by the same method as the baseline, filed in the account
any result beyond what field screening can honestly settle is escalated to an accredited laboratory instead of being interpreted on the spot
revisit_triggers: retest results systematically disagree with what customers perceive
a source-water change is reported in a service geography

nodes.definition: Deciding who pays when something breaks on a plan account, and executing that decision without a fight. The work separates the manufacturer's parts warranty, with its registration requirement, proof of install date, model-specific terms and its list of what voids cover including customer-supplied consumables and unapproved modifications, from the plan's labor promise, from wear items nobody warrants, and from damage caused by conditions outside the equipment's rated operating envelope. It covers registering equipment at install so a claim is possible years later, capturing the diagnostic evidence a supplier will demand, a defined first response to a leak or water-damage event that begins with isolating the unit and notifying the business's own insurance path, and a stated goodwill boundary so field decisions are consistent rather than dependent on who is having a good day.

included: goodwill boundary and its consistent application
excluded: insurance, legal or coverage advice
install workmanship standards and code compliance
product selection and supplier negotiation

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: warranty claim frequency by model class, a supplier terms change, or a water-damage incident review

pros.claim: A written who-pays boundary turns the worst customer moments into a process, and processed failures keep accounts that arguments lose
pros.example: a failed valve handled as a warranty part plus plan labor with the claim evidence captured on the same visit rather than argued about for a fortnight

cons.claim: Firm boundaries occasionally cost a good customer who believed everything was covered, and unlogged goodwill exceptions erode the boundary until it means nothing
cons.example: declining to absorb an equipment cost for a long-standing account and losing both the renewal and the referrals it produced

failure_modes: equipment never registered, so a valid warranty is unclaimable when it is finally needed
improvising the who-pays answer call by call until the rule is meaningless
leaving a leaking unit in service while the parts decision is unresolved
acceptance_tests: every plan account has its equipment registration and install-date evidence retrievable, and every failure closes with a recorded who-pays decision referencing the agreement
any leak event carries an isolation-and-notification step recorded on the day it was found
revisit_triggers: a model class produces repeated warranty claims
supplier warranty terms or claim procedures change

nodes.definition: A disciplined classification of why accounts stop, because the save that works differs completely by cause. Structural exits happen when the house is sold, the household moves or dissolves. Value exits happen when the customer no longer perceives any difference, or when the system was oversold at the start and never could deliver what they were led to expect. Price exits happen when a renewal outgrows the perceived benefit or a cheaper cartridge appears online. Friction exits come from missed windows, chasing to get booked, or a callback nobody returned. Product exits come from repeated failures or a discontinued model with no parts. Involuntary exits, an expired card or an unopened invoice, are not decisions at all. The work is capturing the reason at the moment of exit in the customer's own words, mapping it onto the taxonomy, and attributing it to cohorts such as install year, treatment class, install crew and plan tier, so the pattern behind the anecdotes becomes visible.

included: capture at the moment of exit
separating involuntary payment failure from a decided cancellation
excluded: the save and winback motion itself
price setting
the acquisition promise made before install

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a shift in the mix of recorded exit reasons, or a cohort whose retention curve departs from the rest of the book

pros.claim: Reasons captured at exit turn churn from a number into a fixable list, and the involuntary share is usually the cheapest thing in the business to fix
pros.example: finding that a run of cancellations traces to one crew's over-promising at handoff rather than to plan price

cons.claim: Stated reasons are polite fictions as often as truths, and cohort analysis on a small book is noisy enough to mislead
cons.example: too expensive given as the reason by a customer who actually never got a callback returned

failure_modes: logging every cancellation as price because it is the easiest box to tick
no cohort attribution, so a systemic defect from one install era stays invisible
counting failed payments as churn and never retrying them
acceptance_tests: every closed account carries an exit reason mapped to the taxonomy plus the cohort attributes needed to group it
involuntary payment failures are separated from decided cancellations before any retention figure is computed
revisit_triggers: a cohort's exit pattern changes materially
a new complaint or failure class appears that the taxonomy cannot express

nodes.definition: The motion that keeps an account or brings it back. Renewal is timed before the term ends and built on the evidence the year actually produced: visits completed, parts fitted, the retest comparison, issues raised and how they were resolved. The lapse window is the defined period during which a stopped account is still straightforwardly serviceable and still thinks of itself as a customer. Winback leads with the equipment's present condition and a plain choice, a catch-up service, a move to a lighter tier or the shipment channel, or an honest a-la-carte relationship, rather than with insinuations about what has been happening to their water since they stopped. The unit also fixes when to stop: an account that has declined twice and asked to be left alone is a referral risk, not a pipeline, and the stop rule protects both the customer and the business's reputation in a neighbourhood where everyone talks.

included: renewal timing and the evidence pack it leads with
the stop rule for repeated declines
excluded: fear-based or urgency-manufactured reactivation of any kind
price setting
structural transfers when the property is sold

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: renewal and winback conversion by exit reason, or a complaint that the recovery language crossed the claim boundary

pros.claim: Leading a renewal with the year's own evidence makes the decision concrete and keeps the whole conversation inside the claim boundary
pros.example: a renewal call that opens with the completed visit log and the retest comparison instead of with a discount

cons.claim: Save offers train a subset of customers to lapse deliberately, and heavy winback effort on low-value accounts costs more than it returns
cons.example: a discounted catch-up service the same household waits for every single year

failure_modes: treating a silent automatic renewal as if it were a renewal conversation
winback copy that implies harm has occurred since the service stopped
no stop rule, so declined accounts keep receiving offers until they complain publicly
acceptance_tests: every renewal or winback contact is traceable to evidence in the account and contains no claim outside the claim boundary
a documented lapse window and stop rule exist and are applied consistently across the book
revisit_triggers: lapse-to-winback conversion falls
a complaint arises about winback language, frequency or pressure

nodes.definition: Handling the structural churn event this trade cannot avoid: the house sells and the equipment stays behind. The unit covers the assignment clause that makes a transfer possible at all, the signals that a sale is under way (returned mail, a listing, a neighbour's remark, a call from a home inspector or an escrow officer asking what the equipment is), the offer made to the incoming owner consisting of an orientation visit, the service history and equipment file, and an enrollment decision that is genuinely theirs, and the handling of the outgoing owner, who may want the plan cancelled, prorated, or moved to their new address, which is a fresh install opportunity with a customer who already trusts the business. Done well, one sale produces two accounts; ignored, it produces a system nobody services and a stranger who calls a competitor the first time the taste changes.

excluded: real-estate, escrow or legal advice
sizing and installing equipment at the new address
asserting any jurisdiction's property-disclosure rules as fact

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: detected-versus-missed sale counts in the book and the conversion of transfer offers to enrolled new owners

pros.claim: A transfer motion converts the largest structural churn cause into an acquisition channel with no lead cost
pros.example: an orientation visit for the new owners that ends with both a transferred plan and a request to quote the sellers' new home

cons.claim: Sale timing is invisible unless somebody watches for it, and chasing every address anomaly wastes effort on nothing
cons.example: a returned-mail flag chased for months on an account that had merely switched to paperless billing

failure_modes: discovering the sale only when a scheduled technician meets a stranger at the door
no assignment clause, so the plan simply dies with the transaction
billing the previous owner for services delivered to the new one
acceptance_tests: the agreement contains an assignment path and a proration rule, and every detected sale produces a recorded outcome for both the outgoing and the incoming party
no service is billed to a party who no longer owns the property
revisit_triggers: sales in the book are being detected late or missed entirely
transfer conversion differs sharply between service geographies

nodes.definition: Moving plan prices when the cost stack moves, without detonating the book. The sequence is: re-derive the stack first so the change is justified by named inputs such as a documented supplier increase, freight, labor, or an added inclusion; decide who is affected, who is grandfathered and for how long; give notice by the mechanism the agreement specifies, in language that states the driver plainly rather than hiding behind market conditions; offer a genuine alternative such as a lighter tier, the shipment channel, or a longer interval where the exhaustion mechanism honestly allows one, instead of presenting only a larger number; and then watch the affected cohort's cancellations to learn what the book will bear. The discipline that makes this survivable is that price follows verified cost and delivered value, never a revenue target dressed up as a cost story.

included: cost-driven justification from a re-derived stack
notice mechanism and plain-language driver statement
excluded: naming any price, percentage or benchmark increase
the equipment sale price
contract law advice

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: post-change cancellation behaviour in the affected cohort and any further dated movement in a named cost input

pros.claim: A change tied to named, verifiable drivers and paired with a real alternative keeps most of the book and preserves the honesty the plan was sold on
pros.example: notifying softener accounts of a change driven by a documented salt and freight increase while offering a longer-interval tier as an option

cons.claim: Cost transparency invites line-item negotiation and reveals a margin structure customers had never thought about
cons.example: a customer responding to a freight-driven increase by proposing to buy the cartridges themselves

failure_modes: repricing without re-deriving the cost stack, so the stated driver is a story rather than an input
notice that arrives after the charge has already been taken
raising the price on an account that has an open, unresolved service failure
acceptance_tests: every price change references a re-derived cost stack with dated source documents and is noticed by the mechanism the agreement specifies
no account with an open service failure is included in a price-change cohort until that failure is resolved
revisit_triggers: cancellations rise in a price-changed cohort beyond the pre-change pattern
a cost input moves materially again

nodes.definition: Harvesting the structural advantage this trade has: treated water is visible and socially discussed, in spotless glassware, a kettle without a scale ring, softer laundry and coffee that tastes different, and neighbours drawing on the same municipal supply or the same aquifer usually share the same underlying water problem. The loop asks at the moment proof exists, immediately after a retest comparison or a well-resolved service call; asks for something specific, a named neighbour on the same water or a review that describes what actually changed; keeps the ask inside the claim boundary and far away from health framing; respects the consent record when the referred person is contacted; and discloses any incentive plainly, because referral rewards, review incentives and neighbour-discount schemes sit inside disclosure obligation classes whose rules differ by jurisdiction and by platform and must be verified locally rather than assumed.

included: timing the ask to a documented proof moment
incentive disclosure as an obligation class
excluded: paid acquisition and lead buying
the diagnostic and offer conversation held with the referred prospect
asserting any platform's or jurisdiction's specific incentive rules as fact

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: referral share of new installs, complaints about the approach, or a change in a disclosure obligation class

pros.claim: Referrals arriving from a shared water problem land pre-qualified and cluster geographically, improving route density as well as acquisition cost
pros.example: three houses on one street on the same hard supply, serviced together on the same cluster day

cons.claim: Incentivized asks distort the evidence and put pressure on a customer's own relationships, and a referral that goes badly damages two accounts at once
cons.example: a review incentive that produces enthusiastic health claims the business then has to publicly disown

failure_modes: asking before any proof exists, so the request rests on goodwill alone
incentives that are not disclosed in the review or referral
cold-contacting a referred neighbour who never consented to be contacted
acceptance_tests: every referral or review ask follows a documented proof moment and contains no claim outside the claim boundary
any incentive is disclosed in the ask itself and recorded as an obligation class verified for the operating jurisdiction and platform
revisit_triggers: a review platform or advertising disclosure rule change is reported
referred contacts complain about how they were approached

nodes.definition: The measurement layer that tells the operator whether the annuity is compounding or leaking, defined as computations over their own book rather than as figures to be quoted at anyone. The set that matters here is: attach as enrollments over installs handed off in a period; on-time service as visits completed inside their due window; overdue ageing; lapse and involuntary-failure rates held apart from each other; revenue per active account per year set against its cost-stack counterpart; retention curves by cohort of install year, treatment class and plan tier; referral share of new installs; and callback rate per hundred visits. The work is defining every denominator unambiguously, computing the set on a fixed review cadence from the service book and the ledger, and wiring each metric to the iteration trigger it should fire, rather than publishing comparisons against industry averages nobody can source.

included: metric definitions with explicit numerator, denominator and period
the link from a metric movement to an iteration trigger
excluded: industry benchmark claims or comparisons to figures not computed from this book
accounting and tax reporting
valuation of the business or its book

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a change in the system of record or a metric definition, or a recomputation that disagrees with the previously reported value

pros.claim: Metrics computed from the operator's own book are defensible and directly actionable in a way borrowed benchmarks never are
pros.example: an on-time service rate falling in one geography pointing straight at a route-capacity problem rather than at a vague worry about loyalty

cons.claim: Small books make every rate noisy, and metric definitions drift quietly as tools and job titles change
cons.example: attach rate jumping because deferred decisions were quietly reclassified as enrollments in a new scheduling system

failure_modes: reporting revenue per account without the matching cost stack
changing a denominator mid-year and then comparing across the break
comparing the book against a benchmark figure nobody can trace to a document
acceptance_tests: each metric has a written definition naming numerator, denominator and period, and recomputes to the same value from the service book and the ledger
no reported metric is compared against an external figure that cannot be sourced to a named document
revisit_triggers: a metric definition or the system of record changes
a metric moves outside its normal range and fires an iteration trigger

edges.why_related: an interval is only defensible as a proxy for the mechanism that actually ends the consumable's life
intervals are written per component against the parts list the record holds, so the schema must exist first
consent and retention rules attach to fields of the account record that the book schema defines
the agreement can only promise what the claim boundary permits the business to say the plan does
the cost stack is computed per serviced system per year, which requires knowing how often each component is replaced
an item can only be bundled into a recurring price once its delivered cost is known from the stack
tier content and the agreement's inclusion list are the same promise and must be drafted against each other
the shipment channel is a fulfilment option inside or beside the tiers and needs the tier menu defined first
the handoff enrollment presents the tier ladder and the a-la-carte alternative, so both must exist before the visit
next-due is last-serviced plus the interval the schedule specifies for that component class
the engine reads install dates, component lists and last-serviced dates straight out of the record
the ladder can only ask about work the engine has determined is due, and its copy quotes the component and date
every step of the ladder runs on a channel whose consent state must already be recorded
routes are built from confirmed bookings, so the booking motion feeds the week the planner assembles
the protocol is executed inside the window and with the parts the route plan allocated to that stop
triage runs on the readings, photos and observations the standard visit is required to capture
the retest is taken during the visit, at the same sample point and by the same method the protocol fixes
a supplier claim is only possible with the dated diagnostic evidence the visit record captures
value and product exits can only be classified honestly once the technical cause of a complaint is known
the save motion is selected by exit cause, so the taxonomy must exist before any winback ladder is designed
the transfer motion exists because the taxonomy isolates property sale as a structural rather than a value exit
a price change is only defensible when the re-derived cost stack names the input that moved
the referral ask is timed to a documented proof moment, and the retest comparison is that moment
lapse, save and renewal outcomes are the raw counts the retention metrics are computed from
retest results may be reported only as chemistry against the parameters in scope, never as a health finding or a scare
winback and renewal language is bounded by the permitted claim set, which rules out implying harm has occurred since service stopped
referred contacts and review solicitations are bounded by consent records and by the rule that test results are not marketing material
the notice mechanism, term and grandfathering options available for a price change are exactly the ones the agreement created
cluster days want services moved to fit the route while the schedule wants each component replaced when its mechanism says it is spent
edges.resolution_rule: shift a service only inside the documented tolerance window for that component class; when the exhaustion observable is already present or a breakthrough complaint exists, dispatch off-route and let the mechanism win over the route

edges.why_related: a richer tier sells more easily and retains better while every added inclusion consumes the margin the stack computes
edges.resolution_rule: an item enters a tier only if it passes the predictability-and-cost test against the current stack; otherwise it stays per-event, and any tier whose realised cost breaches the stack is redesigned rather than quietly subsidised

edges.why_related: shipping cartridges is cheaper and often preferred by the customer but removes the inspection, the leak check and the reading that the visit produces
edges.resolution_rule: ship only components that pass the written eligibility rule, and require any shipped account to receive a technician visit on a defined cycle so the inspection and verification reading are not lost permanently

edges.why_related: referral and review incentives reward enthusiastic overstatement of what the system did, which is exactly what the claim boundary forbids
edges.resolution_rule: the claim boundary dominates: asks are limited to what the customer measured or observed, incentives are disclosed, and any review or referral message containing a health claim is corrected or withdrawn rather than left standing

edges.why_related: a dated baseline-versus-current comparison is what makes a renewal decision concrete, so retest discipline moves renewal outcomes
missed windows, callbacks and unfinished visits generate the friction class of exits the taxonomy records
enrollment and the recorded commissioning date come first, and the due-date clock starts from them
field findings of media spent early or barely used are the evidence that retunes the interval for a class or a geography
cohort retention and realised cost per tier are what justify redesigning, merging or retiring a tier
both are enrollment moments in front of a new decision-maker standing at working equipment, and both run an orientation plus an explicit recorded decision

conflict_axes.name: schedule_fidelity_vs_route_efficiency
conflict_axes.description: Servicing each component when its mechanism says it is spent conflicts with batching stops into cluster days that make the margin work.
poles: service on the component's own due date
service when the route is in the area
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: publish a tolerance window per component class and let route batching move work only inside it; an observed exhaustion signal overrides the window

conflict_axes.name: plan_richness_vs_plan_margin
conflict_axes.description: Customers reward inclusive plans while every inclusion consumes margin the cost stack has to carry, especially unpredictable items.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: apply the predictability-and-cost test item by item against the current stack, and price or exclude anything whose frequency the business does not control

conflict_axes.name: technician_visit_vs_ship_to_door
conflict_axes.description: The truck roll is expensive but produces the inspection, the reading and the human relationship; the shipment is cheap but leaves the business blind.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: route by component eligibility and account geography, and require a periodic technician visit even on shipment accounts so verification is never permanently lost

conflict_axes.name: proof_cadence_vs_measurement_cost
conflict_axes.description: Frequent retests make value visible and defend renewals, but each one costs kit, time and the obligation to act on an inconvenient result.
poles: retest minimally to protect visit economics
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: fix a minimum comparison per plan year per class, add cadence only where the source is variable or a concern was raised, and never suppress a result that was taken

conflict_axes.name: renewal_urgency_vs_honest_claim_boundary
conflict_axes.description: The language that most reliably reactivates a lapsed account is fear about what has been happening to the water, which the claim boundary forbids outright.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the boundary wins without exception; urgency may be built only from rated throughput, dated readings and the equipment's condition

conflict_axes.name: term_lock_in_vs_voluntary_loyalty
conflict_axes.description: Longer terms and automatic renewal stabilise the book but transfer risk to the customer and invite disputes; month-to-month keeps everyone honest and volatile.
poles: keep the plan cancellable at will
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: whatever term is chosen, disclose renewal and cancellation prominently, verify the applicable obligation classes locally, and earn the renewal with delivered evidence rather than with friction

conflict_axes.name: price_realization_vs_book_retention
conflict_axes.description: Recovering a cost increase protects the annuity's economics while every increase puts a share of the book into a cancellation decision.
poles: hold price and absorb the squeeze
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: re-derive the stack, change price only against named dated inputs, grandfather or offer a lighter tier, and watch the cohort's cancellations before extending the change

conflict_axes.name: standard_interval_vs_household_tuning
conflict_axes.description: One interval per class is operable and stockable; per-household tuning is more accurate but multiplies variants across scheduling, stock and billing.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: keep a small number of interval bands per class driven by named load variables, and reserve genuine one-off intervals for documented outliers

conflict_axes.name: referral_incentive_vs_disclosure_and_consent
conflict_axes.description: Incentives multiply referrals and reviews but pull against disclosure obligations, consent limits and the accuracy of what customers say happened.
poles: keep asks unincentivized and strictly consented
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: disclose every incentive in the ask itself, verify the applicable disclosure obligation class for the platform and jurisdiction, and never contact a referred person outside the consent record

edge_cases.description: Household composition changes after install, so real throughput diverges sharply from the interval set at commissioning
edge_cases.trigger: a family grows, a household empties, or a rental changes tenants between service visits
edge_cases.mitigation: ask about occupancy and usage at every visit and on the booking confirmation, and move the account to the interval band its load now justifies rather than waiting for a complaint

edge_cases.description: The municipal supply changes disinfectant or blends a different source seasonally, and carbon accounts start complaining with no equipment fault present
edge_cases.trigger: a utility switch, a seasonal blend, or a main repair that alters influent chemistry across a service area
edge_cases.mitigation: treat clustered complaints in one geography as a source-change hypothesis first, confirm against the utility's published information, and re-baseline expectations and intervals for the affected cohort

edge_cases.description: A customer buys generic cartridges online and asks the technician to fit them during a plan visit
edge_cases.trigger: a price-sensitive account substitutes non-specified consumables
edge_cases.mitigation: state plainly what the substitution does to the manufacturer warranty and to what the business can verify, record the customer's decision in the account, and either decline the fit or fit it with the consequence documented

edge_cases.description: The property is sold mid-term, the new owner never signed anything, and a renewal charge lands on the previous owner's card
edge_cases.trigger: a transfer that nobody detected until billing ran
edge_cases.mitigation: stop billing immediately, apply the proration rule, offer the incoming owner an orientation and their own enrollment decision, and treat the exit as structural rather than as a value cancellation

edge_cases.description: An account keeps paying but repeatedly refuses or postpones the service visit, so an unserviced system sits under a live plan
edge_cases.trigger: three or more declined or cancelled appointment offers on a paying account
edge_cases.mitigation: flag the account as paying-unserviced, escalate to a human call explaining what an unserviced system means mechanically, and offer the shipment channel or a pause rather than collecting for undelivered work

edge_cases.description: A softener runs out of salt or the brine tank bridges between visits, and the customer reads the returning hardness as a failed system
edge_cases.trigger: a hardness complaint from a softener account whose salt cadence sits between service visits
edge_cases.mitigation: check salt level and bridging before any resin conclusion, show the customer the difference, and either add salt service to the plan or set an explicit reminder cadence for the household to top it up

edge_cases.description: A retest on a well account comes back worse than the commissioning baseline on a parameter the system was sold to control
edge_cases.trigger: a field retest result that contradicts the system's expected performance on a private-well property
edge_cases.mitigation: report the reading as chemistry without any health framing, escalate to an accredited laboratory rather than settling it on site, and refer well-condition questions to the appropriate licensed well professional instead of proposing a filter as the answer

edge_cases.description: A reverse-osmosis membrane fails early because a neglected prefilter let chlorine through
edge_cases.trigger: a membrane failure inside its expected life on an account with a missed or self-shipped prefilter change
edge_cases.mitigation: establish from the record whether the prefilter change was delivered, fitted or merely shipped, apply the agreement's who-pays rule to that finding, and tighten the fitted-confirmation step for shipment accounts

edge_cases.description: A seasonally vacant home sits unused for months, so time-based rather than volume-based issues dominate at reopening
edge_cases.trigger: an account flagged as a vacation, snowbird or rental-gap property
edge_cases.mitigation: schedule the service to the reopening rather than the calendar, include the sanitizing and flush steps the class requires after stagnation, and record the vacancy pattern so future due dates follow the occupancy cycle

edge_cases.description: During a routine service the technician finds an active leak or an installation detail that looks outside code, possibly from another company's work
edge_cases.trigger: a condition discovered at a stop that exceeds the service scope
edge_cases.mitigation: isolate the unit and make it safe before leaving, document the finding with photographs, disclose it plainly to the homeowner without diagnosing another trade's work, and hand any code, permit or licensing question to the installation and compliance process for local verification

edge_cases.description: A card expires or a direct debit fails and the account quietly stops paying without anyone deciding to leave
edge_cases.trigger: a failed recurring payment with no cancellation request attached
edge_cases.mitigation: separate involuntary failures from decided cancellations, run a retry and a plain contact on the consented channel before any save offer, and never report the account as churn until a person has actually decided
