edge_cases.description: A competitor runs a scare campaign in a serviced neighbourhood and plan customers call anxious or ask to cancel
edge_cases.trigger: door-knocking or advertising in the area that claims the local water is dangerous
edge_cases.mitigation: answer with the customer's own dated readings and the published utility information, correct the specific factual error without mirroring the fear, and offer a retest rather than a counter-scare

workflow.action: Define the per-system service book record
workflow.description: Fix the fields every installed system must carry, including the consumable parts list, commissioning baseline, plan state, consent state and next-due per component
workflow.artifact: service book record schema with a populated example account
workflow.gate: a randomly chosen account can be serviced from the record alone and resolves to a model class, parts list, install date and per-component due date

workflow.action: Write the honest claim boundary for service, renewal and referral
workflow.description: State the permitted claim set, the prohibitions on health framing, fear demonstrations and manufactured urgency, and the care rules for easily pressured customers
workflow.artifact: claim boundary document with permitted and forbidden language examples
workflow.gate: every existing script traces each claim to a measured parameter or a maintenance mechanism and contains no health claim

workflow.action: Derive replacement intervals per treatment class
workflow.description: Map each component to its exhaustion mechanism, take the installed model's rating as the starting point and apply the household load adjustment
workflow.artifact: per-class interval table with the basis named for each component
workflow.gate: every component in the book has an interval whose basis and household adjustment are stated and attributable

workflow.action: Build the service cost stack per model class
workflow.description: Assemble parts, freight, loaded technician time including drive time, vehicle and stock cost, retest cost, callback reserve and billing cost from real documents
workflow.artifact: dated cost stack per model class with a source document named per input
workflow.gate: no input in the stack lacks a dated source document

workflow.action: Design the plan tiers and the a-la-carte fallback
workflow.description: Apply the predictability-and-cost test to each menu item and compose a short tier ladder that the route and parts supply can deliver
workflow.artifact: tier definition sheet with per-item include-or-per-event decisions
workflow.gate: each tier's inclusion list is deliverable on route and matches the agreement text exactly

workflow.action: Draft the plan agreement and disclosure page
workflow.description: Write inclusions, exclusions, term, renewal, cancellation, price-change notice and transferability in plain language and list the obligation classes to verify locally
workflow.artifact: one-page plain-language agreement plus an obligation class checklist
workflow.gate: every regulatory point appears as an obligation class flagged for local verification rather than as an asserted rule

workflow.action: Set up consent capture and record hygiene
workflow.description: Capture per-channel consent with timestamps, wire opt-out propagation across every tool, and fix retention and internal access limits for test results
workflow.artifact: consent and retention policy with the capture form and opt-out flow
workflow.gate: a test opt-out suppresses every channel and list, and every contactable account carries a dated channel consent state

workflow.action: Attach the plan at install handoff
workflow.description: Run the enrollment on the commissioning evidence, present plan and a-la-carte side by side, and record an explicit decision with consent
workflow.artifact: handoff enrollment sheet with the recorded decision and consent state
workflow.gate: every handoff produces enrolled, declined or deferred with a date, and first due dates are computed from the commissioning date

workflow.action: Stand up the due-date engine and work queue
workflow.description: Compute next-due per component, group components inside the tolerance window, and produce a rolling queue with overdue ageing
workflow.artifact: rolling due and overdue work queue
workflow.gate: every due date reproduces from last-serviced plus interval plus recorded adjustments, and overdue accounts carry an age

workflow.action: Run the reminder and booking ladder
workflow.description: Send the consented escalating sequence naming the component due, offer one-step booking with windows, confirm, and stop at the defined point
workflow.artifact: reminder sequence definition with per-step outcomes recorded
workflow.gate: no message sends without a consent state, every step names the component, and the sequence terminates with a recorded outcome

workflow.description: Work the geographically batched week, verify against the record, replace what is due, leak-check on reassembly, take the verification reading and the plan-year retest, and debrief the homeowner
workflow.artifact: completed visit record with parts, readings, photos, leak check and updated due dates
workflow.gate: no visit closes without a leak-check confirmation, a post-service reading and updated next-due dates

workflow.action: Measure book health and run the retention motions
workflow.description: Compute attach, on-time service, overdue ageing, lapse split from involuntary failure, revenue against cost stack, cohort retention, referral share and callback rate, then fire the iteration triggers they point at
workflow.artifact: book health review pack with metric definitions and triggered actions
workflow.gate: every metric recomputes from the book and the ledger and no figure is compared against an unsourced external benchmark

priority_rationale: The foundation nodes come first because nothing downstream is operable without them: the service book defines the record every other mechanism reads and writes, the claim boundary governs what may be said in every later conversation, the exhaustion mechanisms are what any interval is a proxy for, and the agreement plus consent rules bound what can be promised and sent. Annuity design follows, because intervals must exist before a cost stack, and a cost stack before any tier or shipment channel. Attach, the due-date engine, the reminder ladder, routing and the visit protocol form the delivery chain in the only order that works, since each consumes the artifact the previous one produces. Proof, drift diagnosis and warranty handling sit on top of the visit because they read its captured evidence. Churn classification, renewal, transfer, price governance and referral come last among the operating units because each needs delivered service history to act on, and book health metrics close the loop by measuring the whole chain and firing the iteration triggers.

dominance_rules.rule: The honest claim boundary dominates every service, renewal, winback and referral script
dominance_rules.rationale: a single fear-based or health-flavoured claim can destroy the trust the whole annuity rests on and expose the business to a complaint it cannot defend
dominance_rules.trigger: any customer-facing message, visual or demonstration about why service or renewal is needed
dominance_rules.action: strike any claim that cannot be traced to a measured parameter or a documented maintenance mechanism, and never present a spent consumable or a chemistry trick as proof of danger

dominance_rules.rule: Documented exhaustion evidence dominates route convenience
dominance_rules.rationale: route density is an efficiency gain while breakthrough is a service failure the customer experiences directly
dominance_rules.trigger: a cluster day would push a component past its tolerance window, or an exhaustion observable is already present
dominance_rules.action: dispatch off-route or reschedule the cluster; never let batching carry a component past its documented window

dominance_rules.rule: Safety and leak risk found on site dominates the day's schedule
dominance_rules.rationale: water damage is the one failure mode in this trade that turns a service call into an insurance claim and a lost customer at once
dominance_rules.trigger: an active leak, a failed fitting, or an unsafe condition discovered at a stop
dominance_rules.action: isolate and make safe before leaving, document it, and push the remaining appointments rather than the repair

dominance_rules.rule: The written agreement dominates verbal promises made at the door
dominance_rules.rationale: recurring relationships are settled years later from the document, not from anybody's memory of a conversation
dominance_rules.trigger: a customer asserts a coverage or renewal term that the agreement does not contain
dominance_rules.action: honour the written terms, correct the source of the verbal promise, and amend the agreement if the promise should have been true

dominance_rules.rule: Plumbing-code and contractor-licensing obligation classes dominate any task that leaves the service envelope
dominance_rules.rationale: service work that drifts into installation, repiping or drain modification crosses into requirement classes that vary by jurisdiction and are not this process's to settle
dominance_rules.trigger: a service visit would require altering plumbing, drains or connections beyond replacing what was installed
dominance_rules.action: stop, hand the work to the installation and compliance process, and verify current local code and licensing requirements before anything is changed

dominance_rules.rule: A dated measurement dominates an assertion, whoever makes it
dominance_rules.rationale: customers, competitors and salespeople all assert things about water; only a reading taken the same way as the baseline settles a dispute
dominance_rules.trigger: a disagreement about whether the system is performing
dominance_rules.action: take or retrieve a reading at the baseline sample point and method, and escalate to an accredited laboratory when field screening cannot honestly settle it

dominance_rules.rule: Consent and do-not-contact state dominates the reminder and referral machinery
dominance_rules.rationale: an opt-out breach costs the account permanently and may breach an obligation class the business has not verified
dominance_rules.trigger: any automated or manual outreach to a customer or a referred contact
dominance_rules.action: check the channel consent state first and suppress the contact if it is absent, regardless of how due the service is

dominance_rules.rule: Resolving an open service failure dominates collecting a renewal or applying a price increase
dominance_rules.rationale: billing into an unresolved complaint converts a fixable problem into a cancellation and a public review
dominance_rules.trigger: an account with an open callback, unresolved drift or pending warranty claim enters a renewal or price-change cohort
dominance_rules.action: hold the billing action until the failure is closed and recorded, then proceed

dominance_rules.rule: Manufacturer-specified consumables dominate cheaper substitutes when the business is certifying the system
dominance_rules.rationale: the plan's performance promise and the equipment warranty both rest on the specified part, and a substitute silently moves the risk onto the business
dominance_rules.trigger: a customer supplies or requests a non-specified cartridge, media or membrane
dominance_rules.action: explain the warranty and verification consequence, record the customer's decision, and either fit the specified part or document the substitution and what the business can no longer promise

anti_rework_rules.rule: Define the service book record fields before building any reminder or scheduling automation
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an automation built on fields that do not exist, which forces a full re-entry of the installed base once the first due dates are wrong

anti_rework_rules.rule: Derive the per-class exhaustion mechanism and interval before pricing any tier
anti_rework_rules.prevents: tiers priced on an assumed service frequency that field evidence then contradicts, forcing a price change in the first year

anti_rework_rules.rule: Build the cost stack from real documents before publishing a tier or a plan price
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering after enrollment that drive time and callbacks make a whole tier unprofitable, which can only be corrected by a churn-inducing reprice

anti_rework_rules.rule: Capture channel consent at the handoff, before the first reminder falls due
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unreachable book whose accounts must be re-consented one call at a time, and outreach that breaches a consent obligation class

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the claim boundary before writing any renewal, winback or referral script
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rewriting an entire script library and retraining after a complaint, and unwinding claims already made to customers

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record the commissioning baseline at handoff before promising any retest comparison
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a proof-of-value retest with nothing to compare against, which turns the plan's strongest renewal argument into an argument about method

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm parts availability and lead time for a model class before enrolling it on a plan
anti_rework_rules.prevents: plan promises on discontinued or long-lead equipment that cannot be serviced on schedule, producing refunds and product-class exits

anti_rework_rules.rule: Settle the who-pays boundary between warranty, plan labor and wear items before the first failure
anti_rework_rules.prevents: improvised failure decisions that become precedent, and warranty claims lost because registration and evidence were never captured

anti_rework_rules.rule: Put the assignment and proration clause in the agreement before the first house in the book sells
anti_rework_rules.prevents: structural churn that cannot be transferred, plus billing disputes with an owner who no longer holds the property

iteration_protocol.trigger: service visits repeatedly find a class of media spent before its scheduled date or barely used at it
iteration_protocol.action: retune the interval band for that class or geography, notify the affected cohort, and recompute the cost stack the new frequency implies

iteration_protocol.trigger: booking conversion falls at a step of the reminder ladder or opt-outs rise after a copy change
iteration_protocol.action: retune step timing, channel and wording inside the consent rules, and re-measure conversion before extending the change to the whole book

iteration_protocol.trigger: lapse rate rises in a cohort beyond its established pattern
iteration_protocol.action: run the exit taxonomy over the recent closures, separate involuntary failures, and adjust the save motion to the dominant cause rather than to price by default

iteration_protocol.trigger: a named cost input moves, whether parts, freight, labor or processing
iteration_protocol.action: re-derive the cost stack first, then decide grandfathering, notice and alternatives before any price moves

iteration_protocol.trigger: a source-water change is reported or inferred from clustered complaints in one geography
iteration_protocol.action: re-baseline retest expectations for the affected accounts, re-check intervals for the classes that carry that load, and prepare a plain factual explanation for customers

iteration_protocol.trigger: a complaint alleges pressure, scare tactics, an over-promised outcome or an undisclosed incentive
iteration_protocol.action: audit every script and referral asset against the claim boundary, retrain whoever spoke, and review the agreement disclosures the complaint touched

iteration_protocol.trigger: a warranty claim pattern appears on one model class
iteration_protocol.action: escalate the pattern to the supplier with the captured evidence and reconsider whether that class should keep being enrolled on plans at current terms

iteration_protocol.trigger: a run of property sales appears in a cohort, or transfers are being detected late
iteration_protocol.action: work the transfer motion across the affected accounts, tighten the sale-detection signals, and recount the active book before reporting retention
